source: Flames rise from a 5-foot cube of ground within your view. Any creature standing there when it ignites, or ending its turn in it, makes a Dexterity saving throw or takes 1d8 fire damage. Unattended flammable objects in the cube catch alight.
Green-Flame Blade

Strike a creature within 5 feet with the weapon you cast this through. On a hit the weapon does its usual work, and emerald fire jumps from that target to one other creature you pick within 5 feet of it, burning the second for fire damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.
Gust

You seize the air and push it. Choose one: a creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet, an unattended object weighing up to 5 pounds flies 10 feet, or you create a harmless sensory effect of wind.
Infestation

Biting vermin boil over a creature you can see within range for a moment. Failing a Constitution saving throw costs it 1d6 poison damage and sends it stumbling 5 feet in a randomly determined direction, which can provoke opportunity attacks.
Lightning Lure

A lash of lightning snaps out at one creature within 15 feet. On a failed Strength saving throw the creature is dragged up to 10 feet straight toward you, and it takes 1d8 lightning damage if that leaves it within 5 feet.
Magic Stone

Charge one, two or three pebbles at a touch. Thrown or slung by you or anyone you hand them to, each is a ranged spell attack dealing 1d6 bludgeoning damage plus your spellcasting ability modifier on a hit.
Mind Sliver

A shard of psychic force punches into the thoughts of one creature you can see within range. On a failed Intelligence saving throw it takes 1d6 psychic damage and, still reeling, subtracts 1d4 from its next saving throw made before your next turn ends.
Mold Earth

You choose a 5-foot cube of loose earth within range and either excavate and move it, turn it into difficult terrain or smooth it flat for an hour, or reshape its colours and contours into shapes and words.
Primal Savagery
Your teeth lengthen, or your nails do, dripping acid. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet; a hit deals 1d10 acid damage. The change fades once the attack is resolved.
Sapping Sting
One creature you can see within range makes a Constitution saving throw. Failure drains the strength from its legs: 1d4 necrotic damage, and it drops prone.
Shape Water
You choose a 5-foot cube of water within range and either move it 5 feet, change its colour or opacity, form it into simple shapes, or freeze it solid provided no creature is inside.
Spray of Cards
You fling a spray of razor-edged conjured cards. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 slashing damage.
Sword Burst
Spectral blades sweep outward around you for an instant. Every other creature within 5 feet takes 1d6 force damage unless it succeeds on a Dexterity saving throw.
Thorn Whip

A thorned vine lashes from your hand. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within range; on a hit it takes 1d6 piercing damage, and anything Large or smaller is hauled up to 10 feet toward you.
Toll the Dead

Point at a creature you can see within range and a funeral bell rings out around it. On a failed Wisdom saving throw it takes 1d8 necrotic damage, or 1d12 instead if it has already lost any hit points.
Word of Radiance
Burning light bursts out of you at a divine word. Each creature you single out within 5 feet takes 1d6 radiant damage unless it succeeds on a Constitution saving throw.
Absorb Elements

Some of the incoming energy is drawn into you rather than through you. The triggering damage type is halved against you until your next turn begins, and the first melee hit you land on your next turn carries an extra 1d6 damage of that same type.
Armor of Agathys
Spectral frost sheathes you and your gear, granting 5 temporary hit points. Any creature that lands a melee attack on you while even one of those points remains suffers 5 cold damage.
Arms of Hadar

Dark tendrils erupt from you and lash out. Each creature within 10 feet must make a Strength saving throw, taking 2d6 necrotic damage on a failure and half as much on a success. A creature that failed cannot take reactions until the end of its next turn.
Beast Bond

You touch a beast with an Intelligence of 3 or lower and form a telepathic link with it. While the link holds you can perceive through its senses, it understands your simple commands, and you have advantage on attack rolls against any creature within 5 feet of it.
Cause Fear

One creature you can see within range is made to feel its own death coming. On a failed Wisdom saving throw it is frightened of you until the spell ends, with another save at the end of each of its turns. Constructs and undead feel nothing.
